About.title: Dr. Nasim Gholami
About.lead: Choosing medicine and aesthetic practice was a decision of both heart and mind: the rational Nasim inside me chose treatment, helping people feel better, while the artist — painter and sculptor — wanted to bring that eye for beauty to faces and to the people behind them.
About.description: The result, after years of work, is the DN (Doctor Nasim) practice — where those aspirations become reality. Membership of the American Academy of Dermatology and keeping up with the latest protocols underpins every decision made here.
